{{Quote|You must be Shara? You don't look like any bounty hunter I've ever seen.''"<br />"''Let's just say we both hung out with the wrong crowd in the past.|X2 and Shara, upon first meeting each other|<ref name="Elite Squadron" />}}
'''Shara''' was a former [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who was inducted into [[Grey Squadron]] by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Rahm Kota/Legends|Rahm Kota]] and fought with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
[[File:SharaX2_Yavin.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Shara and X2 on Yavin]]
Shara was a bounty hunter before the Galactic Civil War, and was brought into [[Grey Squadron]] by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] Rahm Kota. During the course of the war she aided [[X2]] in the battle of [[Evacuation of Yavin|Yavin 4]], in which she helped Rebel soldiers and personnel to evacuate the planet before the Empire could destroy them in revenge for the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. Later on, at some point during the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] era, X2 discovered the location of his twin brother X1 on [[Vjun/Legends|Vjun]].

Shara participated in the [[Battle of Vjun]] alongside [[Grey Squadron]], allowing Rebel troops to infiltrate [[Bast Castle]] and to stop the Imperial Remnant. X1, however, escaped the battle, fleeing to his cloning laboratory on [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]]. Shara fought with [[Grey Squadron]] at the [[Battle of Mustafar (Galactic Civil War)|Battle of Mustafar]], while X2 went to rescue the captured [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] before he could be cloned by X1. At the climax of the battle, X2 defeated his twin brother, rescuing Skywalker and ending a threat to the nascent New Republic. Some time later, Shara and X2 became part of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] with Luke Skywalker and the new galactic government.

==Behind the scenes==
Shara was originally created for the cancelled ''[[Star Wars: Battlefront III]]'' from [[Free Radical Design]]. She would instead go on to be used in the [[2009]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Battlefront: Elite Squadron]]''. In a leaked build of Battlefront III for the Wii, her full name was given as Shara Vale.
